notes.subject: התפלשתי
notes.rationale: form is first-person 'I rolled myself' (ASV) but context is imperative 'roll thyself' (KJV/JPS); imperative read here.

notes.subject: עפרה/עפר
notes.rationale: town name בית לעפרה puns on עפר 'dust' — 'house of dust, roll in dust'; kept by gloss धूरी के घर।

notes.subject: imperatives
notes.rationale: verse is a chain of direct commands — do not tell, do not weep, roll in the dust — addressed to the people.

notes.subject: to the people of Judah
notes.rationale: second-person plural commands address the threatened towns directly.

translation: गत (गथ) में मत कहऽ; बिलख-बिलख के मत रोवऽ; बेत-लेअफरा (धूरी के घर) में धूरी में लोटऽ।
